::: {#def-ordered-rooted-tree}
#### Ordered rooted tree

An **ordered rooted tree** [@wikipedia_tree_graph_theory] is a rooted tree (@def-rooted-tree)
in which the children (@def-tree-child) of each vertex are listed in an order: a first child, a second child, and so on.
We draw the children of each vertex from left to right in their order.

:::
